name: zfmv_action_play_avi_update
description: zFMV_ActionPlayAvi::Update latches the first update time, computes a video frame index from elapsed time and stream FPS, skips repeated frames, decodes new frames, blits the stream image, adjusts surfaces, and propagates decode failure.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja still carries a bounded stack-merge warning at 0x463779, and tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV PlayAvi/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4636d0 validates the thiscall Update contract: latch startTimeSec when lastDecodedFrameIndex is negative, compute frameIndex as (timeSec - startTimeSec) multiplied by stream->videoFramesPerSecond at offset 0xec and converted through _ftol, skip decode/blit on repeated frame index, branch on renderer path 2 for the 3DFX surface-adjust mode, call zFMV_Stream::ReadAndDecodeFrame for new frames, always run the blit and surface-adjust path after a new-frame decode attempt, store lastDecodedFrameIndex, and return the decode result.
The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zFMV_Stream::ReadAndDecodeFrame, zVideo postprocess/unlock/adjust providers, and the runtime blit dispatcher are accepted for the functional lane.

The native smoke verifies first-call latching, same-frame fast path, software renderer postprocess/unlock/blit/adjust behavior, 3DFX blit/adjust behavior, stream FPS frame-index calculation, and decode-failure return propagation.
